user.title: Connect PagerDeck
user.description: Create an ingest key for a source in the PagerDeck dashboard and paste it here. Alerts sent from Home Assistant arrive on that source.

data_description.api_key: The key starts with `src_live_` and is shown once when the source is created.
data_description.url: Only change this for a self-hosted or local PagerDeck API.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate PagerDeck
reauth_confirm.description: PagerDeck rejected the saved ingest key. Enter a valid ingest key.

data_description.api_key: The key starts with `src_live_` and is shown once when the source is created.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to PagerDeck. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: The ingest key was not accepted.
error.invalid_url: Enter a URL that starts with http:// or https://.

abort.already_configured: This ingest key is already configured.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach PagerDeck. The alert was not sent.

incident_not_found.message: No open incident exists for this dedup key.

invalid_auth.message: PagerDeck rejected the ingest key. Reauthenticate the integration.

payment_required.message: The PagerDeck account has no entitlement to send alerts.

rate_limited.message: PagerDeck is rate limiting this source. Retry after {retry_after} seconds.

send_alert.name: Send alert
send_alert.description: Sends an alert to PagerDeck with severity, tags and an incident key.

message.name: Message
message.description: Body of the alert. Used as the title when no title is set.

title.name: Title
title.description: Headline of the alert, up to 250 bytes.

severity.name: Severity
severity.description: Proposed urgency. Without it the default of the source applies.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Up to 20 tags of at most 64 bytes each.

dedup_key.name: Dedup key
dedup_key.description: Keeps an incident together. While it is open, the same key updates the first alert instead of creating a new one.

url.name: URL
url.description: Link opened by the app. Only http and https are accepted.

ttl.name: Time to live
ttl.description: Delivery deadline and auto-resolve, between 1 second and 30 days.

resolve.name: Resolve incident
resolve.description: Closes the open incident that was created with this dedup key.

dedup_key.name: Dedup key
dedup_key.description: The key the incident was opened with.
